description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application for managing user operations such as registration, updating, and retrieval within an internet banking service.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A REST controller handling user-related HTTP requests such as registration, updating, and retrieval.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to register a new user with the provided user data.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP PATCH requests to update an existing user's data identified by user ID.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of all users.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve information of a specific user by ID.
